Hello dear friend, 
This is Vietnam Animal Vet Clinic. We are one of the Animal vet clinic in Vietnam working to help the #pets, #animals for being stronger and healthier! We have saved and treated for over 1000+ Sickness Pets in vietnam! 
We really want to share with you guys about a #veterinarian work and also how we treat for pets and animals here in Vietnam! 
Our channel is about: 
- Doing treatment and take care for serious sickness #cats and #dogs!
- #Cats and #Dogs #rescue and #saving! 
- Special VIP service for #Pets 
- Self – Caring Knowledge for #pets and #animals! 

Follow us at: Vietnam Animal Vet Clinic  https://bit.ly/39KuFtN
 Contact us at: #Vietnamanimalvetclinic 
Fan page:

Website: Updating 
Gmail:nongloan00@gmail.com
